llm_response.reason: Multiple independent reports flag the domain as an online shopping scam. Key scam traits are present: unrealistic discounts, fake/copied legal and privacy pages, lack of real company or customer support info, and anonymous ownership. Site content is hidden or minimal (from extraction), matching patterns of scam sites that rotate or obscure main content. The domain piggybacks on credibility (news/health) and uses psychological manipulation tactics like urgency (limited-time discounts). There is no evidence of legitimate business operation.
